item.title: ‘We can’t vote on hope’: West Contra Costa school board slashes hundreds of positions
item.description: All departments, from administrators to gardeners and cafeteria workers to teachers and class room aides, will be impacted by the reductions, approved Wednesday.

item.title: San Jose police rein in license-plate reader policies as surveillance-tech debate rages
item.description: SJPD is preserving the use of the city's 474 Flock cameras — as other jurisdictions are dropping them — but is changing retention and access rules following wide public outcry that includes civil-rights litigation.

item.title: Oakland school district lays off hundreds of workers to balance $100M deficit
item.description: Oakland Unified School District's Board of Directors voted to layoff 421 employees Wednesday evening to close a $100 million budget deficit

item.title: Dispute at downtown San Jose business ends in shooting
item.description: One man was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder and another was treated for injuries at an area hospital.

item.title: San Jose: Condominium sells for $1.3 million
item.description: The condominium located in the 2800 block of Monroe Terrace in San Jose was sold on Jan. 16, for $1,255,000, or $833 per square foot. The condo, built in 2013, has an interior space of 1,507 square feet. The apartment has three bedrooms and three bathrooms. The property is equipped with a heating system and a cooling system. Additionally, the condo includes access to two parking spots.

item.title: Flock plate reader use ends in Cupertino and Saratoga
item.description: The sheriff’s office says it is barred from using the cameras under a new policy adopted by the Board of Supervisors.

item.title: CCS basketball playoffs: Thursday’s semifinal scores, updated matchups
item.description: Results from Thursday night's Central Coast Section boys, girls basketball semifinals in Divisions I through V.

item.title: Third period miscues cost Sharks in another loss to Calgary Flames
item.description: NHL: Tyler Toffoli scores as San Jose Sharks face Calgary Flames to begin a six-game homestand

item.title: Willow Glen starts fast, holds off Burlingame to reach CCS D2 final
item.description: Under first-year coach Patrick Judge, Willow Glen is one win from the program's first CCS title in 57 years.

item.title: CCS basketball playoffs: Best of Thursday’s semifinal games
item.description: Milpitas rolls into Division I boys final, seeks first title since 1997. St. Francis, SHC, HMB boys also advance. Girls semifinal winners include Menlo-Atherton, Valley Christian.
